traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Cymodoceaceae: leaves alternate or opposite; leaves simple; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes none; plants dioecious; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary or in cymes; perianth absent; fruit nut; stamens 2; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
